implemented_slices: Same-service executor peers cannot amend or void another executor's released result; state, audit and outbox remain unchanged on denial.
Admission reads and patient diagnostics filter by the actor's admission department scope.
Item authorization precedes recollection-state lookup, removing a foreign-item state oracle.
Manager mobile navigation has one query-aware active route.
Compact logout is available in the topbar at every breakpoint.
Queue cards are the source of truth through 960px; workflow confirmation surfaces above fixed navigation.
Degraded patient-workspace copy reflects the authorized request snapshot instead of claiming a confirmed flow.
Auxiliary Patient Workspace reads have an explicit failure boundary that returns DEGRADED while preserving authorized requests; injected failure is covered by a focused test.
Released reports expose only clean finalized attachments; pending and quarantined attachment metadata is denied by regression coverage.
Post-critic mobile readability pass increases Patient Workspace secondary text sizes and reserves safe bottom space for fixed navigation; core and accessibility E2E remain green.

All application command replay paths now reauthorize the actor/resource boundary before returning a cached idempotent response; actor-scoped request projection is centralized in request-projection.ts and focused HTTP, workflow and result regressions cover representative revocation cases.
The durable outbox worker now closes its cached PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY adapter before the runtime store during graceful shutdown; focused architecture, realtime and runtime tests remain green.

External malware scanner configuration now fails closed without an exact approved-host allowlist, rejects unsafe URL components/unapproved IP literals and disables redirect following; boundary tests cover the policy.

Realtime snapshot/stream replay now includes committed PENDING or PROCESSED domain events while suppressing PROCESSING and FAILED delivery rows; HTTP and stream regressions cover all three delivery states.
AppShell preserves the native EventSource reconnect cursor, announces bounded polling fallback, and the current browser matrix proves an open screen reconciles a committed mutation without reload.
PostgreSQL rate-limit coverage now includes twelve concurrent attempts against a quota of three, window reset and invalid URL/pool fail-fast configuration.

HTTP structured logger emits only allowlisted bounded fields, normalizes caller-controlled correlation to external, redacts clinical/sensitive values and swallows writer failure without changing the request response; focused tests cover normalization and disablement.
The local mutation sentinel detects 7/7 deliberate auth, version, migration, upload, outbox, realtime and recovery mutations in an isolated temporary copy.

The shared ActionButton primitive now exposes an explicit idle/pending/confirmed/failed/unknown/denied state contract, blocks duplicate pending/denied activation, and is consumed by workflow, patient creation, login, logout, notification acknowledgement and administration command surfaces with focused UI coverage.

ResultView now derives busy from a per-action pendingAction, so release, review, upload and editor/invalidation controls expose aria-busy only on the active transaction; 19 component tests cover the pending/idle and duplicate-submission contract.
Focused service, projection-SQL, PostgresStore, S3 adapter and relational-read tests extend current behavior evidence without touching live infrastructure.
The CI verify job now invokes the same mutation sentinel after coverage; remote execution remains an open gate until a clean CI run is observed.
Coverage report aggregates executable layers, applies global 90/90/85 thresholds and exposes 39 below-threshold files without silently excluding hard persistence/UI layers.
The AAA-3 candidate verifier fails closed on artifact, coverage, fresh-review, release-disposition and working-tree fingerprint drift.
CI verification now generates and uploads a CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM with 560 components under Node 22 after JSON parsing validation.
Incident, outbox, storage/scanner, realtime, security and closure runbooks are documented locally with explicit non-claims for target RPO/RTO, failover and production release.
